blocking.title: After year 1 the land war has no battles: armies stand in piles at home while land changes hands without contact. Engaged land formations worldwide at years 10 and 20 on 24 worlds: mean 0.3-0.7 of about 300 belonging to nations at war (year 1: 55-107). Seed 6421 year 21: 0 engaged at all 25 fortnightly samples with 7-9 wars and 309-7,179 cells flipping per fortnight. At war, the UK keeps 85 of 160 divisions at London (7019) and 60 idle at Wick (1129, where a Soviet A-bomb kills 665,160 of them). Late air battles 120 a year against 3,160 in year 1. Same on bcbc99c (1.1 and 0.3): newly measured, not a regression; the read ADR-577 deferred to this report.
blocking.fix: Make a nation at war send its standing armies to its fronts and over the sea to its enemies (the invasion AI, PLAN 4.6b, with the idle piles as its pool), so that contact after year 1 is in proportion to the wars running. Measure engaged formations per war-year after year 1 against year 1, on unseen seeds.

blocking.title: The AI still H-bombs a city of a million at the utility floor, and re-strikes the same few thousand men; PLAN 7.38's bar fails on an unseen seed. Seed 1129: Soviet Union on Greenock, hydrogen bomb, 1,105,514 dead (34,514 men) at utility 0.026. Seed 2081: Germany strikes one spot three times in 184 days for 5,179, 3,879 and 4,090 men.
blocking.fix: Weigh the dead so a floor-value strike cannot pay for a city (DEAD_COST 0.1 a million lets 0.13 of value buy a million dead); choose fission where the target is a few divisions; extend ADR-569's no-restrike-without-new-value to a spot struck within the last year. Measure on seeds the rule was not tuned on.
